name: Saul
overview: The name Saul appears in Scripture as a king reigning in Edom, specifically Saul of Rehoboth by the river, who succeeded Samlah and was himself succeeded by Baalhanan (Genesis 36:37-38; 1 Chronicles 1:48-49). The city of Gibeah, associated with Saul, is noted in Isaiah 10:29 as a place of refuge during times of fear and conflict. Hosea 13:11 reflects God's sovereign control over Saul's kingship, indicating that He gave Saul as king in anger and removed him in wrath, underscoring divine judgment in the establishment and removal of leadership.
